Observe creatures living in the Naguri River (Iruma River) in early autumn while enjoying fishing, learning about the connections between riverside wildlife, and identifying water-quality indicator species.

【Fee】
Adults ¥5,000 / Students ¥4,000 / Preschool children ¥2,500 (includes guide, insurance, materials)

【Capacity】
20 people per date

【Guide】
Mori no Field Academy (森のフィールド学舎) staff

【What to bring】
Drinks, change of clothes, hat, lunch

【Notes】
Mori no Field Academy website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
